name: 3302-material-stripes
about: jt-stripes attaches its glTF sphere beside the player, its material drawn through the mod's own surface shader shaders/Stripes (plan 3.4: cooked at install by G's cook, its programs built here, their flags from the cook's flags.tsv): white with still blue bands 25 units high, lit by the stage as the game's own models are (the lit flag: shading and a highlight on both colours, the bands' blue darker on the shadowed side), not the placeholder and not flat (a person's look, then the reference)
